verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs say its remote MCP Server lets users "analyze your data using natural language… without writing SQL". That covers both read-only and read-write SQL (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, schema changes via query_rw). Dives are built and refined through conversational prompts ("add a filter for US region", "switch to a bar chart"), and built-in AI functions offer SQL generation. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation, natural-language control shown mainly for data and visualization tasks rather than administration (sharing, billing, instance sizing), and a reliance on an external AI client for the MCP path.
